purpose: Learning line for parsing sentences: which parts, which sentence structures and how many hand-written or two-verb sentences per school year (3-6).
details: Year 3-4: pv and o only; year 5: lv and mv; year 6: all parts incl. predicates and adverbials, sentences without lv and sentences with two finite verbs. Dividing the sentence first is only on early years; step-by-step is off in year 6. Loaded by kern/leerlijnen.py (laad/parameters) which the topic's generator calls with the child's school year; checked by tests/test_leerlijnen.py and turned into the handbook tables by docs/tools/handleiding.py.

field_notes.explanation: The stored skill id this learning line belongs to; the same as the file name. Stored ids are never renamed.
A short Dutch description of the skill (shown in the handbook and reports).
Goals of the skill (a list; empty for most skills).
The parameters of this skill and their type name (lijst, int, bool, tekst, getal); a value of the leerlijn must match.
Per school year (3, 4, 5, 6, m1, m2) the parameter values; a missing or null year means the skill is not offered then (the level cannot be chosen).
The parts of the sentence the child must find that year (pv, o, then lv, mv; on the hardest level also wwg, nwg, bwb).
Whether the first step is dividing the sentence into parts.
The sentence structures the sentence machine may build.
The tenses of the verbs in the sentences (tt = present, vt = past).
Whether the step-by-step scheme is the default (false = typing the form directly).
Whether sentences without a direct object occur.
The school years of the hand-written, fully analysed sentences that are mixed in.
How many of ten questions come from the hand-written list.
The structures of sentences with two finite verbs.
How many of ten questions have two finite verbs.
